title: A People's History of the United States
author: Howard Zinn
summary: Howard Zinn retells American history from the perspective of the people usually left out, including Native Americans, enslaved people, workers and women. It is openly written as a counterweight to standard accounts.
readIf: you want a history told from the bottom up and are ready for a strong point of view.
skipIf: you want a balanced survey or a neutral account of events.
